notes: Letter fly-through (transition letter) into the next shot: creator loves it.
Ghost words (pale words that fill in as spoken): creator likes the typography.
Plinth with smoke and the rotate-push camera move on images: creator doesn't like them; don't use.

When a line mentions a list, options, picks or several items (including the CTA 'saare X ki list chahiye?'), show those items themselves as 2-4 tilted photo cards with short lowercase handwritten labels, below the words: creator loved this.
Learned styles are techniques to adapt, not colour schemes: re-colour and restyle them to each reel's own palette and mood (black-and-white or the source's colours are never required).
Show the subject: a shoe reel shows shoes (products, close-ups, waist-down), not full-body models on every beat; models on at most ~30% of beats.
No text behind or over a model: words go beside or above him.
Typography beats get a supporting product cutout in the bottom-right corner; only 2-3 pure-text beats per reel.
Images should move: varied entrances, and images slide out as the next comes in (no plain fades).
